mapper.select: SELECT ccode, userId, passwd, userNm, userUuid, userType FROM GESTURE_FORUM_USER WHERE userUuid = #{userUuid}
SELECT ccode, userId, passwd, userNm, userUuid, userType FROM GESTURE_FORUM_USER WHERE userId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GESTURE_FORUM_USER ( userId, passwd, userNm, userUuid, userWaitCd, countryCd, picture, userType, socialType, snsSignId ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{passwd}, #{userNm}, #{userUuid}, #{userWaitCd}, #{countryCd}, #{picture}, #{userType}, #{socialType}, #{snsSignId} )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND userType != 'WITHDRAW' THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND userType = 'WITHDRAW' THEN 2 END AS cnt FROM GESTURE_FORUM_USER WHERE userId = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE b, c FROM GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_HEAD_LIKE AS b ON a.ccode = b.ccode LEFT JOIN GESTURE_THREAD_POST_LIKE AS c ON a.ccode = c.ccode WHERE a.ccode = #{ccode} AND a.userId = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE GESTURE_FORUM_USER SET passwd = '<WITHDRAWAL>', userNm = '<WITHDRAWAL>', userType = 'WITHDRAW', useYn = 0, outDate = NOW() WHERE ccode = #{ccode} AND userId = #{username}
